issue.title: hishel_ttl not written to storage
issue.body:
According to the [docs](https://hishel.com/dev/metadata/#hishel_ttl), an httpx request that includes `hishel_ttl` should override the storage's default ttl. ```py response = client.get( "https://api.example.com/data", extensions={"hishel_ttl": 3600} ) ``` But that doesn't seem to be the case. In the example below, two requests with `hishel_ttl=999` are dispatched and the storage has `default_ttl=0` (no caching). I was expecting the second request to use the cache but both hit the server.
example ```py from hishel.httpx import SyncCacheClient from hishel import BaseFilter, SyncSqliteStorage, FilterPolicy, Request """ rm .cache/hishel/ttl_demo.sqlite pkill -9 -f 'http.server 1234' python -m http.server 1234 & python test.py (one liner) rm .cache/hishel/ttl_demo.sqlite; pkill -9 -f 'http.server 1234'; python -m http.server 1234 & python test.py --- # Server sees 2x requests but the second request should have been from cache Serving HTTP on 0.0.0.0 port 1234 (http://0.0.0.0:1234/) ... 127.0.0.1 - - [03/Mar/2026 13:33:10] "GET / HTTP/1.1" 200 - 127.0.0.1 - - [03/Mar/2026 13:33:10] "GET / HTTP/1.1" 200 - """ def main(): client = SyncCacheClient( storage=SyncSqliteStorage( database_path="ttl_demo.sqlite", default_ttl=0, ), policy=FilterPolicy( request_filters=[CacheEverythingFilter()], response_filters=[CacheEverythingFilter()], ), ) resp = client.get( "http://localhost:1234", extensions={"hishel_ttl": 999}, ) print(resp.extensions["hishel_from_cache"]) # False resp = client.get( "http://localhost:1234", extensions={"hishel_ttl": 999}, ) print(resp.extensions["hishel_from_cache"]) # False class CacheEverythingFilter(BaseFilter): def needs_body(self) -> bool: return False def apply(self, item: Request, body: bytes | None) -> bool: return True main() ```
This seems to be because `SyncSqliteStorage.create_entry()` [serializes the request / response](https://github.com/karpetrosyan/hishel/blob/31099e327035bf0e4d9265ca50124593a48eccf0/hishel/_core/_storages/_sync_sqlite.py#L141-L144) with `pack()`. And `pack()` [deletes](https://github.com/karpetrosyan/hishel/blob/31099e327035bf0e4d9265ca50124593a48eccf0/hishel/_core/_storages/_packing.py#L13) `hishel_ttl`. So `hishel_ttl` is never written to the db and when the cached request is [checked for expiry](https://github.com/karpetrosyan/hishel/blob/31099e327035bf0e4d9265ca50124593a48eccf0/hishel/_core/_storages/_sync_sqlite.py#L297) the `default_ttl` is always used. Or maybe I'm totally misreading and doing something dumb.

expected.cause: The metadata filter in hishel/_core/_storages/_packing.py strips every request extension whose key starts with hishel_ before storing, including hishel_ttl, so the documented per-request TTL never reaches the storage and default_ttl applies.
